thread:
len: Pushed a quick mock for the trace side-panel. Trying a top-right placement for the correlation id + copy button instead of inline. Figma link: https://figma.com/s/sidepanel-trace-mock

neha: Top-right looks cleaner but might be disconnected from the stack frames. Could we mirror a tiny anchor near the request header too?

tom: Agree. Also raising export placement: should the primary action be a single "Export (ndjson)" button and the chevron open other formats? Feels faster for power users.

raul_infra: Backend note: permalinks need snapshot_id and shard so they don't 404 during rollouts. We'll emit a stable token that maps to index+snapshot. For bulk exports, ndjson is best—CSV flattens frames badly.

tara_a11y: A11y notes: copy button should have aria-label="Copy trace URL" and after copy announce "Trace link copied to clipboard" with role="status". When sidepanel opens, trap focus and set aria-modal. Avoid moving focus unexpectedly on toast.

len: Wording question: "Copy trace link" vs "Copy permalink". I prefer explicitness: "Copy trace link".

neha: Also visual truncation: show first 8 + ellipsis then last 4, but include full id in aria-label and tooltip. Add keyboard hint in tooltip like "Press c to copy".

tom: Keyboard sketch for implementers: when panel focused: c -> copy trace link; e -> open export menu; d -> quick export last trace; Esc -> close panel. Tab should cycle inside.

raul_infra: We'll add endpoints: /traces/resolve?stable_token=xxx -> {index, snapshot_id}, and /traces/export?format=ndjson&range=... Good to be explicit in permalinks.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: trace-permalink-stable-token -> staging at 03:10 UTC :rocket:

len: Thanks all. I'll update the mock: move copy to top-right, change label to "Copy trace link", add visible 3px focus ring and tooltip with keyboard hint, and set export primary to "Export (ndjson)". Will post updated screenshot here tomorrow.
